note: Reviewed corrections of Wikidata labels (node scripts/city-names.mjs applies them): the name players know and that fits a label, not the formal or disambiguated item title. pt = Brazilian Portuguese (D-212): where Wikidata has no pt-br label the European pt label is used, so pt-PT spellings are corrected here.

de.name: New York
de.why: label is the formal 'New York City'; German says New York

pt.name: Nova York
pt.why: pt-br label 'Nova Iorque' is the European spelling

de.name: Washington
de.why: drop ', D.C.' like the EN/PL names

de.name: Tel Aviv
de.why: label is the municipality 'Tel Aviv-Jaffa'; EN/PL use Tel Aviv

pt.name: Bruxelas
pt.why: pt-br label 'Cidade de Bruxelas' names the municipality

fr.name: Asunción
fr.why: fr label lost the accent; French usage keeps it

es.name: Hyderabad
es.why: es label 'Haidrābād' is a transliteration with a macron

pt.name: Cidade do Kuwait
pt.why: no pt-br label; pt 'Kuwait' is the country

de.name: Naher Osten
de.why: de label is the English 'Middle East'
